verdict.rationale: Quo's pricing page lists "Custom ring orders" for shared numbers and its homepage claims call routing to the right person, which covers ordered group ringing. Its MCP docs confirm that missed calls go to voicemail with transcripts. Missing for 10: explicit simultaneous-ring mode, documented forwarding of unanswered calls to another number, and in-depth setup docs or independent hands-on corroboration of ring-group behavior.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can ring a group in order or simultaneously, and route unanswered calls to voicemail or another number

citations.quote: Custom ring orders ... Call transfers ... Phone menus
